# K2 Base - K2 Systems

Our innovative planning tool K2 Base enables fast, safe and accurate planning of PV projects. In just five steps, you can determine the optimal design of your K2 mounting system and the configuration of your PV project. And all of this is free of charge! No wonder K2 Base has become one of the most popular planning tools in the industry.

 Your browser does not support the video tag.

### The optimum K2 mounting system in 5 steps

*   Google Maps integration and graphic drawing tools facilitate your planning
*   Automatic determination of wind and snow loads
*   Intuitive editor for drawing roofs and module arrays
*   Automatic calculation and depiction of roof fasteners and ballasting
*   Result report including assembly plan and bill of materials

Data directly transferable into planning tools from SolarEdge, SMA, Fronius, Kostal, GoodWe, PV\*SOL premium and archelios™ Pro!

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-work.jpg)![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-work.jpg)

### Plan using our intuitive software

You can use K2 Base via the Web through any PC or Mac without any additional software installation. This way you always have all of your projects in view – clear, in overview form and well structured. Project lists offer you useful filtering options and show you all the important parameters. Satellite images can be used as a basis for planning. Graphical work functions optimally with easy drawing tools.

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-info-01.jpg)

### Innovative planning tool

*   Creation of multiple roofs and module fields in one project
*   Working with satellite images and uploaded images (such as drone images, drawings, etc.)
*   Automatic determination of wind and snow loads

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-info-02.jpg)

### Complete result report: everything documented precisely

*   Detailed information on verification system utilisation
*   Automatic calculation and display of roof fastenings and ballasting
*   Editable bill of materials with module distribution per roof
*   Share projects with other people – even outside your own organisation
*   Structural analysis report, assembly plans and ballasting in the form of PDF reports

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/04/K2-Base-info-03.jpg)

### Send items directly to the shopping carts of your distributor’s webshops

K2 Base has added an interface to the webshop of many PV and electrical wholesalers. This feature simplifies and speeds up the planning and ordering process because K2 Base sends the item list directly to the shopping cart of various webshops**.**

![](https://k2-systems.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/K2-Base-info-webshop-en-3.gif)

# Solar API coverage | Google for Developers

**European Economic Area (EEA) developers**

The Solar API provides solar data for hundreds of millions of buildings across the world. [Imagery quality](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/solar/reference/rest/v1/dataLayers#imageryquality) can be `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `BASE`.

*   **`HIGH`:** Solar data is derived from aerial imagery captured at low-altitude and processed at 0.1 m/pixel.
*   **`MEDIUM`:** Solar data is derived from enhanced aerial imagery captured at high-altitude and processed at 0.25 m/pixel.
*   **`BASE`:** Solar data is derived from enhanced satellite imagery processed at 0.25 m/pixel.

The Google Maps Platform team is constantly working to improve coverage for our API services. This interactive map shows where `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, and `BASE` quality solar data is available.

The coverage map also shows where [detected arrays](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/solar/reference/rest/v1/buildingInsights/findClosest#detectedarrays) data is available.

Latitude and longitude coordinates can be obtained using other Google Maps Platform APIs, such as the [Geocoding API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/geocoding) or the [Places API (New)](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service). Coordinates can also be extracted from maps created using the [Maps Javascript API](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript). For example, see [Getting Lat/Lng from a Click Event](https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/javascript/examples/event-click-latlng).

# 3D Basisvoorziening (OGC API)

## 3D Basisvoorziening - Collections

De 3D Tiles Gebouwen worden gegenereerd door met behulp van de BAG-geometrie de gebouwen te modelleren in LoD 2.2. Waar geen AHN gegevens beschikbaar zijn, worden de gebouwen weergegeven in LoD 1.3. De hoogte van deze LoD 1.3 gebouwen is gebaseerd op puntenwolken gegenereerd uit luchtfotobeelden. De 3D Tiles Gebouwen zijn beschikbaar in het (OGC) 3D Tiles formaat ten behoeve van visualisatie doeleinden. Deze wordt alleen aangeboden in de meest recent beschikbare jaargang, zie tabel 1 in de…

# swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 Beta

Published on 4 June 2026

swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 beta is a dataset containing buildings as 3D-models including roof geometries and roof overhangs. Two sets are available: a model depicting closed buildings and a model showing separate elements (roofs, facades and footprints). swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 beta is an improved version of swissBUILDINGS3D 2.0. 

![swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 Beta: 3D building models of Switzerland](https://prod-swisstopoch-hcms-sdweb.imgix.net/dam/en/sd-web/7BHRQ9PxHWM5/Header-build3D3.jpg?auto=format)

## NEW: Building models with EGID in 19 cantons

With the current release of swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 Beta, swisstopo provides building models structured according to the federal building identifier (EGID) and containing the EGID as additional information. The data are available in the cantons AG, AI, AR, BE, BL, BS, FR, GL, JU, LU, NE, NW, OW, SG, SH, SO, SZ, TG, UR and the the city of Zurich.

## 3D building models of Switzerland

### Production methode

The digital ADS aerial photo-strips serve as the base data for the extraction and modelling of the buildings. Based on these images, the roofs are manually extracted in 3D, using the photogrammetric method of digital image (stereo) correlation, enhanced with additional information. The corresponding footprints and facades are then derived in an automated process.  

### Applications

swissBUILDINGS3D 3.0 Beta offers an ideal 3D basis, particularly for the use in architecture, planning and engineering offices, as well as software developers or governmental authorities. The depiction of buildings are paramount within a digital landscape model, hence swissBUILDINGS3D is frequently used for:  

*   3D visualizations and 3D web platforms
*   Basis for urban and spatial planning, residential development projects, mobility, telecommunications or energy
*   Visibility and shadow analyses
*   Various distribution analyses (e.g. of noise, air pollutants, electromagnetic radiation)
*   Calculation of solar potential
*   Simulation of natural disasters
*   Ecology and urban climatology

Sunny Design
With Sunny Design software, you can plan tailor-made PV systems for your customers. It could be a grid-connected PV system with or without a battery-storage system, smart energy management or e-mobility, an off-grid island or hybrid system - Sunny Design takes all technical specifications for the various components into account and provides you with relevant data for a cost-effective assessment of the system. That means that you can match your PV systems to suit the circumstances on-site.
It couldn't be easier. Simply open Sunny Design in your web browser or on your iPad or Android tablet and enter the necessary data in the user-friendly interface. In just a few minutes, Sunny Design will configure the ideal PV system for your customers on your behalf.
You can use Sunny Design free of charge.

Sunny Design PRO
In addition to the PV system, Sunny Design PRO takes battery-storage systems and thermal components, such as combined heat and power plants and heat pumps, into account in system planning. That means that you can plan and simulate comprehensive sector-linked energy systems. Using customized purchase and feed-in tariffs as well as detailed project and capital costing, you can create reliable efficiency forecasts for the entire system. The extensive project documentation helps with field sales meetings and simplifies subsequent energy system implementation.
It's easy: you can give Sunny Design PRO a try with a month-long free trial. Enter your data to receive a comprehensive and professional visualization of the energy system in no time at all.

New features
Further optimization for planning teams in Sunny Design: Teams can now be granted permissions for selected projects instead of the entire project list.
You can set a custom cover page for the project documentation or project exposé in the user settings.
Grouped buildings are displayed as a single object in the roof and string layout.
For CORE2 and STP125, a notification appears when the voltage difference between MPPTs exceeds 80 V.
The algorithm for generating inverter design proposals has been revised.
Sunny Design now uses the language settings from the SMA ID.
Numerous additional improvements and optimizations.
Release Notes Sunny Design 6.00
New features
Teams of multiple system planners can now collaborate in Sunny Design to jointly access and work on projects. This update includes an administration area for creating teams and inviting members, roles and permissions, dedicated team workspaces, and project access management.
One of the project images can now be selected to appear on the cover page of the project documentation. This feature enhances the ability to customize documentation for both customers and the company.
The results now also display the delivered reactive work.
Roof planning
Image overlays in visual roof planning allow you to use your own high-resolution 2D drone images, aerial photographs, or site plans as the basis for planning. Imported images can be freely measured, scaled, and rotated.
Objects such as chimneys, skylights, and more can now be freely rotated on flat roofs.
Sunny Design PRO

For dynamic rates, time series with 366 days can now be imported.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.90
New functions

Import of incomplete consumption profiles is now possible as a 2-column csv file (auto detection). This must contain a date column and a value column.

The Project documentation page has been optimized to ensure a quick and easy access to all downloads.

Buildings and Objects can be combined and be rotated, shifted etc. as one unit.
Different color schemes can now be selected for strings to improve distinctiveness.
Sunny Design PRO
Time Series for PV production can be uploaded and used for calculation (instead of PV system setup and simulation).
In Energy System projects, a tariff module type “Dynamic tariff (time series)” is available. It enables the import of time series for energy demand prices. These can be used to simulate energy costs.
Imported 3D models may contain objects that are removed before PV installation (as antennas or vents). By selecting the checkbox "Disable collision detection", these can be ignored when assigning modules.

A video on the tools for parameterization according to VDE AR-N 4110 has been integrated.
The system validation according to RGIE, Art. 48 (750 V DC) in Belgium has been revised.

Individual modules or module groups can now be rotated in a module field.
Flat roofs can be drawn with any floor plan.
In the case of trailing dormers and trapezoidal dormers, the angle of inclination of the main surface can be changed.
In the case of the building, various roof coverings and wall materials for the facade can now be visualized.
Various objects can now be placed on facades (doors, windows, ventilation grilles and balconies).
When changing modules, the design is retained if the modules have the same width and length.
The map size can be adjusted manually using a slider.
Roof plans can now be saved more easily.
The hiding of shaded PV modules has been improved.
A warning appears when the maximum number of subsystems is exceeded.
The sun position indicator is now enabled by default and can be turned off via the menu at the bottom left.
Sunny Design PRO
The import of 3D models has been improved. The model files can be imported via drag and drop, with up to 10 files per model supported.
In the case of energy system projects, the function "Open overview of electricity purchase costs" is now available on the Results/Profitability page, which can be used to view a detailed analysis of the electricity purchase costs.
Release Notes Sunny Design 5.61
New Functions
On the personal start page, the peak power and a roof planning symbol are displayed for the projects.
It is now possible to choose between a uniform charging tariff for all charging stations or different charging tariffs for each type of charging station.
The simulation of energy system projects with only PV and batteries is now carried out with the same calculation components as for the PV projects and is therefore significantly faster.
Deleting of own locations has been improved.
The project documentation page displays a note about the SMA certification service (for Germany only).
Roof Planning

Modules can be placed across two adjacent and equally inclined surfaces.
The string design now has the option to automatically determine the optimal string alignment and starting point.
When roof objects are moved, existing PV modules are automatically removed or added.
If the length of a hipped roof changes, the inclination of the hip roof is maintained. The inclination of the hip can be adjusted by means of an angle input.
Collision detection for large module fields has been optimized.
